outputs.explanation: Panel A shows a single deconvoluted native MS spectrum for PacL1 with cadmium; it is a single raw measurement with no averaging, error bars, or statistics, so replicate reporting does not apply.
Panel B shows a single deconvoluted native MS spectrum for PacL1Δ5; it is a single raw measurement with no averaging, error bars, or statistics, so replicate reporting does not apply.

Panel C displays single-value fractions of protein bound to 0-3 cadmium atoms derived from one native MS spectrum per condition; there are no error bars or averaged values indicating replication, so no replicate reporting is required.

Panel D displays single-value fractions of protein bound to 0-3 zinc atoms derived from one native MS spectrum per condition; there are no error bars or averaged values indicating replication, so no replicate reporting is required.

Panel E displays single-value fractions of protein bound to 0-3 copper atoms derived from one native MS spectrum per condition; there are no error bars or averaged values indicating replication, so no replicate reporting is required.

Panel F displays single-value fractions of protein bound to 0-3 manganese atoms derived from one native MS spectrum per condition; there are no error bars or averaged values indicating replication, so no replicate reporting is required.

Panel G shows per-residue chemical shift perturbation values from a single NMR titration series at three metal equivalents, with no error bars or averaging across replicate experiments, so replicate reporting does not apply.

Panel H shows per-residue chemical shift perturbation values from a single NMR titration series at three metal equivalents, with no error bars or averaging across replicate experiments, so replicate reporting does not apply.
